bm_desc: IDFC First Bank Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Annual General Meeting held on August 31, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
IDFC First Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 25, 2026.

IDFC First Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 25, 2026, titled "Press Release - Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of IDFC FIRST Bank Limited for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.".
IDFC First Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026.
